task: Deepen flagship 9 (league-schedule-generator): a bigger timetable neighbourhood for the floor-priced carry-over search
goal: Close the 20-team break gap the floor-priced search left (40 to 48 breaks at ~516-550 carry-over).
notes: threeRoundDeals(opp,[r,s,t]) lists every legal re-deal of three rounds' matches (every proper 3-edge-colouring of their cubic graph: each perfect matching times 2^cycles; ~117 deals, 0.7 ms at 20 teams), and floorPricedSingleRounds takes deals=0.15 of its moves there, scoring all deals on carry-over and pricing only the 3 cheapest on the proved break floor. Sweep at 20 teams, seeds 1-3, same cached lists, 3,000 moves (eval/floor-priced.txt): least carry-over at 48 breaks 410/408/426 -> 384/374/384; seed 1 joins 5 frontier seasons instead of 3 (456/46 where nothing was under 534, 516/44, 524/42) and the mean cut inside the gap goes 5.97 -> 8.58% (s2 10.14 -> 10.78, s3 11.15 -> 13.70); 1.2-1.5x the time. Run alone the re-deal search lost seasons on some 17- and 18-team seeds (a different random walk), so carryOverFloorPriced now searches each cap twice, swaps alone and with re-deals, and keeps the better: over 9 page runs (17, 18, 20 teams, seeds 1-3) the cut inside the gap rises in 4 and holds in 5, none falls; 13-42 s on the worker against 4-21 s. Also fixed: a search now keeps the season it started from as a candidate, so it can never return more breaks than its start (13 teams returned 13 against the start's 12). Verified here: node --test floor-priced.test.mjs 14/14, python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py league-schedule-generator ok (192.6s), venture-preflight.
